# Haunt

> GPS-triggered audio tours of haunted, true crime, and historical places. Narrated like a secret shared after midnight. Coming soon to iOS.

## What it is
Step near a place and its story finds you. No screens. No maps. Just the street, and a voice that's been here longer than the buildings.

## Key Pages
- [Home](/): waitlist + product overview

## Status
- Pre-launch (waitlist open). iOS app coming soon.
- Best experienced after dark, walking, with headphones.
